_comment: CritterLifegain (2026-09-08). Ranger-Captain of Eos's ETB tutor-to-hand must open the acquisition re-solve at SEARCHED depth (the spell-tutor arm existed; the creature-ETB arm did not, so the fetch waited a turn at every d>0). Board: 4 Plains + Soul Warden. Hand: Ranger-Captain (3 mana). Library: exactly one MV<=1 creature (Soul's Attendant) so the fetch is forced. Same-turn cast: T4 Warden 1, T5-T7 RC 3 + Warden 1 + Attendant 1 = 16 by T7 = lethal at 16. A turn-later cast deals 15 by T7 and wins T8. NOTE the horizon: a fixture whose max_turns ends the game this turn makes BOTH the land drop and the fetch worthless to the search (it declines them as a tie), so the guard is the win turn, not this turn's life.
